transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Can I just check—do we actually have one person who’s accountable for the pitch, or is that still up in the air? Last time things slipped because it wasn’t clear.

transcript.name: Helena Baxter
transcript.text: We're not doing the hand-wringing again. Wei, you're owning the pitch. If anyone disagrees, speak up right now—otherwise, we get behind Wei and deliver. No more dithering.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Alright, Wei's leading, that's clear. Just want to make sure—do we all know what we're handling under Wei, or should we walk through the breakdown real quick? I'd rather not trip over each other.

transcript.name: James Thornton
transcript.text: Wei, you're in the hot seat, but before we charge ahead, can we get a rough map—just bullet points—of who's got what? Even two minutes now saves us grief later.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Could we just walk through who’s handling what under Wei? I want to make sure nothing falls through the cracks this time.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Wei, could we just list out who’s handling each piece? Even a quick rundown makes things easier for me. I just want to be sure I’m not doubling up with anyone else.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Wei, just to be clear—am I still covering the financial trend analysis, or is someone else taking that on? I’d rather check now than scramble later.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: I’m handling the integration endpoints, same as before. If anything’s shifted, just let me know.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Maybe it helps if we just go around and say what each of us thinks they’re covering. If something overlaps, we catch it now. I’m still on supplier coordination, unless that’s changed?

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Could we clarify which piece I’m covering? I think I was on data pipeline reliability, but want to be sure nothing’s changed.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Trang, I had you down for the data pipeline, too. Unless Wei or anyone else has reassigned it, I think that's still yours. Wei, can you confirm?

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Just want to hear it straight from you, Wei—am I officially on pipeline reliability? Fine either way, just checking.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Would it help if we just each said, out loud, what we think we’re handling? That way, if something’s doubled up or missing, we catch it now. I can start if that helps.

transcript.name: James Thornton
transcript.text: Alright, I'll spell out mine. I’m covering architecture review and technical risk assessment for the pitch. If anyone else thinks they’re on that too, say so now. Otherwise, let's just each call our piece and flag overlaps as we go.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: I’m still covering onboarding documentation and the benefits overview for the pitch, right? That’s what I have down, but shout if I’m missing something.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Looks like we’re covered on most fronts. I’ll stick with the technical validation and system checks, unless someone else was planning to jump in there. Just flag me if you need backup.

transcript.name: Helena Baxter
transcript.text: Wei, give us the list—fast. No more going around in circles. Say who's on what, if anyone disagrees, speak up. Otherwise, move.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Alright, here's the breakdown: Lilian, you’re handling financial trend analysis. Amitesh, you’ve got integration endpoints. Erik’s on supplier coordination. Trang, pipeline reliability is yours. James, you’re covering architecture review and technical risk. Lucía, onboarding docs and benefits overview. Todd, technical validation and system checks. If I missed anything or got it wrong, speak up now.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Thanks, Wei. I’ll need updated numbers from finance before I can finish my part. Can someone confirm if those are already available, or should I reach out?

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Does anyone already have the updated finance numbers? If not, I can reach out, but just checking before we double up.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: I haven’t seen the updated finance numbers yet. Has anyone here already got them? If not, just let me know and I’ll reach out.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: I haven’t seen the new numbers either. If it helps, I can ping the finance team real quick—unless someone else is already on it?

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Lucía, if you're on it, that's fine by me. Just let us know what you hear back so we can keep things moving.

transcript.name: Helena Baxter
transcript.text: Lucía, you chase finance, everyone else—heads down on your piece. If you’re blocked, say so now. Otherwise, stop waiting and get moving.

transcript.name: James Thornton
transcript.text: If anyone hits a snag, flag it quick. Let’s not wait until things break—just call it out and we’ll sort it. Otherwise, let’s get to it.
